title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mjcp: vec_bool_to_bitmap hardcodes WINDOW_SIZE instead of using receiver's window_size field
description: The new vec_bool_to_bitmap() helper introduced in this commit hardcodes the global constant WINDOW_SIZE (63) when computing bitmap positions (line 1045: 1u64 << (WINDOW_SIZE - 1 - i)). This free function is called from std_ext::FragmentReceiver methods where the receiver's own window_size field may differ from the global constant. While the sender always uses WINDOW_SIZE=63 for window sizing (so the mismatch doesn't currently manifest), a receiver configured with a different window_size would produce ACK bitmaps with positions mapped relative to WINDOW_SIZE (63) instead of its own window_size, causing incorrect mapping for non-default window sizes. The function should accept a window_size parameter or be made a method on FragmentReceiver that uses self.window_size.
